why: The question 'What revenue will GreenCart report for FY2027?' names the period but not the material that settles it, the fourth-quarter earnings release and annual report for fiscal 2027.

The Neutral rung 'No decision has been announced and GreenCart has not withdrawn its filing' does not say what it is neutral against, the clearance on condition of store sales that the article says analysts widely expect.
The not_judged entry for 'the final price paid' gives as its reason only the same words, 'the final price paid', which does not say why the part is left out.
The refusal 'The question belongs to another company' does not name that company, FreshWay Foods.
Fiscal 2028, the year ending January 2028, is next year on 2026-12-10 by the fiscal-year note, not 'a year beyond next year', so the case named does not apply and the refusal is not justified.
